Question 16
?

Let B={2,3,4}. Which set is equivalent to the following relation on B? R={(x,y)∈B2:6∣xy}

a
{(2,2),(3,2),(3,4),(4,3),(4,4)}
b
{(2,3),(3,2)}
c
{(2,3),(3,2),(3,4),(4,3)}
d
{(2,3),(3,4)}
e
{(3,4),(4,3)}
